raw.title: Great Famine (Ireland)
raw.extract: The Great Famine, also known as the Great Hunger, the Famine and the Irish Potato Famine, was a period of mass starvation and disease in Ireland from 1845 to 1852. With an excess death impact of 775,000 to 1.5 million, and related mass emigration of 1 million or more, it constituted a major historical social crisis and had a significant impact on Irish society and history.
